topics.title: Nvidia vs. Broadcom: Which AI Chip Stock Is the Better Buy Now?
topics.description: How much will Nvidia's maximum potential guarantee liability under the SB Energy/OpenAI affiliate infrastructure leases be at its next annual report?
topics.outcome: The maximum potential amount guaranteed, any amounts paid or accrued, and the remaining term of the guarantees disclosed in Nvidia's next annual report.

topics.title: Nvidia vs. Broadcom: Which AI Chip Stock Is the Better Buy Now?
topics.description: How much of Nvidia's $279 billion of supply and capacity commitments will remain outstanding or unconditional at its next annual report?
topics.outcome: The total supply and capacity purchase commitments and the portion that is adjustable or cancelable at a cost, as disclosed in Nvidia's next annual report.

topics.title: 3 Overlooked Growth Stocks Powering Every AI Chip Nvidia and AMD Build
topics.description: By how much will contract prices for AI-server memory (HBM/DRAM) — the memory input cost embedded in Nvidia's GPUs — rise or fall in calendar 2027?
topics.outcome: The change in HBM/DRAM contract prices over calendar 2027, and the memory makers' reported average selling prices and memory gross margins for the periods covering 2027.

topics.title: Prediction: $500 a Month Invested in Nvidia Stock Will Be Worth This Much by Year-end 2030
topics.description: How much combined capital expenditure will the five largest hyperscalers — Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft, Meta Platforms and Oracle — spend in calendar 2026 and calendar 2027?
topics.outcome: The big five hyperscalers' combined capex for calendar 2026 and calendar 2027, versus the approximately $800 billion for 2026 and roughly $1.3 trillion for 2027 the article reports they plan to spend.

topics.title: Nvidia Stock Forecast: Rubin Ramp and $108 Billion Q3 Outlook Keep AI Growth Accelerating
topics.description: Will Nvidia complete its approximately $12.93 billion acquisition of Hugging Face — and at what final cost and regulatory conditions — by the check date?
topics.outcome: Closing or termination of the signed Hugging Face acquisition, the final consideration paid (roughly $11.9 billion to shareholders plus up to $1 billion of equity-based retention awards), and any conditions regulators impose.

topics.title: ASML vs. Nvidia: Which AI Semiconductor Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
topics.description: Will the U.S. licence requirement on Nvidia's data center chips still bar it from China's data center compute market at Nvidia's fiscal 2027 year-end, or will it be lifted before then?
topics.outcome: Whether the U.S. export-licence requirement on Nvidia's H20-class data center products remains in force or is lifted, and whether Nvidia resumes recognizing data center compute revenue from China.

topics.title: Nvidia (NVDA): Is There Still Room to Run?
topics.description: Will Nvidia's Rubin data center GPU — the next generation of the product that carries Nvidia's data center revenue — reach volume ramp in the quarter management describes, or slip into calendar 2027 because of memory shortages?
topics.outcome: Whether Rubin's volume ramp and shipments occur in the quarter Nvidia describes (about 20% of data center revenue) or are pushed into calendar 2027, and whether reported sales timing slips.

topics.title: Nvidia (NVDA): Is There Still Room to Run?
topics.description: How much residual-value/loss-share exposure has Nvidia taken on under its customer data center financing support — the commitment to cover up to 25% of the loss if financed chips lose value — and how much is disclosed at its next annual report?
topics.outcome: The maximum potential amount of Nvidia's loss coverage on customer data center chip values, any amounts paid or accrued, and the terms and remaining duration of that support, as disclosed in Nvidia's next annual report.

topics.title: Nvidia (NVDA)’s $20 Billion Groq Deal Faces a Legal Test. Does It Matter for NVDA’s Valuation?
topics.description: Will Nvidia's Groq 3 LPX rack-scale LPU system — the first product built on the Groq technology it paid about $20 billion to license and staff — reach volume shipments and commercial scale in the quarter Nvidia describes (its fiscal Q3 FY2027), or slip?
topics.outcome: Whether Groq 3 LPX volume shipments occur 'later this quarter' as Nvidia stated, and whether the system begins contributing to reported data center revenue or slips into fiscal Q4 FY2027/calendar 2027.

topics.title: Nvidia GPUs are everywhere. Here are the ways companies are accessing them
topics.description: What will the hourly spot rental price for Nvidia B200 GPUs be at the end of calendar 2026, after more than doubling from March 2026 to October 2026?
topics.outcome: The hourly spot rental price for Nvidia B200 GPUs at year-end 2026 and whether it remains above its March 2026 level.

topics.title: NVIDIA in Talks to Acquire Reflection AI, Valued at $25 Billion
topics.description: Will Nvidia sign and complete an acquisition of Reflection AI — and at what consideration and terms — by the check date?
topics.outcome: A definitive agreement to acquire Reflection AI, its closing (or the talks' collapse), and the final consideration paid and any regulatory conditions imposed.

topics.title: If I Had a Choice to Invest $10,000 in SpaceX or Nvidia, Here's What I Would Do
topics.description: How much will global AI capital spending total in calendar 2026 and calendar 2027?
topics.outcome: Global AI capex for calendar 2026 and calendar 2027, measured against Goldman Sachs' forecast of $1 trillion of global AI spend this year and AI spend equal to 1.8% of U.S. GDP in 2026, 2.5% in 2027 (and 2.8% in 2028).

topics.title: Nvidia’s Equity Investments Consume Half Its Free Cash Flow. Can the Payout Pace Last?
topics.description: How much of Nvidia's $25 billion of equity-investment commitments outstanding at July 26, 2026 will be funded or remain outstanding at its next annual report?
topics.outcome: The remaining balance of Nvidia's equity-investment commitments, the cash paid to fund them, and any change in the committed amounts, as disclosed in Nvidia's next annual report.
